common.promptStandard: Purpose: authored company decor for open storage and static tabletop display. Specification: shelves are 1.00m wide x 1.80m high x 0.35m deep with 0.92m x 0.31m x 0.035m boards at the declared support heights, ornaments use a 0.16m x 0.12m x 0.20m envelope. Units are metres, up is +Y, forward is +Z, and the ground or prop origin is the declared bottom centre. Installation and load bearing: shelves are ground-blocking facilities, ornaments are bottom-centred support-surface props. Keep all structure outside each rectangular support clearance prism. Budget: deterministic CPU-only primitive geometry and binary GLB export with no external art. State: static decor, no pickup or animation. Source/export: project-authored Three.js 0.187.0 parameters, GLTFExporter and GLTFLoader readback.
